newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thailand's PTTEP raises capital in trading unit.
newsitem.headline: Thailand's PTTEP raises capital in trading unit.

text.p: Thailand's PTT Exploration and Production Plc (PTTEP) said on Wednesday that it had agreed to buy 240 million shares at 10 baht per share in its unlisted trading arm, PTTEP International Ltd.

The purchase would raise fully paid up capital in PTTEP International to three billion baht ($115 million), while PTTEP would remain as 99.99 percent majority shareholder, the company said in a filing to the Thai stock exchange.
PTTEP is the exploration unit of state-owned Petroleum Authority of Thailand (PTT).
"The purpose of the capital increase is to boost efficiency and flexibility of the PTTEP group's financial management," the company added.
